quarterly_data.quarter: Black Forest Labs press release: FLUX 3 Image Klein: open weights, 5.6B parameters (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Black Forest Labs released FLUX 3 Image Klein, a 5.6B-parameter open-weights model for text-to-image generation, image editing and multi-reference generation with up to 10 reference images (native 4K generation, bounding-box control), with a base model for fine-tuning and a step-distilled model, plus FP8, INT8 and NVFP4 builds developed with NVIDIA support, under the FLUX Kommunity License; optimized for consumer GPUs. In internal evaluations it ranks first in text-to-image, multi-reference generation and image editing ahead of larger open-weights models (company claim).
